title: PAR-20/7G.3 RenderPreset key and OBJECTS identity closure
scope: Audit the generated RenderSettings/PLOTSETTINGS graph for unique root identity and OBJECTS handles.
Require exactly one ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS NOD entry, owner-0 NOD identity, and unique nonempty handles across OBJECTS.
Retain existing render/page-setup owner closure and local serialization-order checks.

sourceChange.change: The RenderSettings callback route counts ACAD_RENDER_PLOT_SETTINGS entries, checks owner zero for the actual NOD, and rejects missing or duplicate OBJECTS handles.
sourceChange.reason: The test previously used last-match root assignment and checked only the three expected object record positions, leaving duplicate root keys and unrelated section-wide handle collisions undetected.
